name: Rishi Bommasani
bio: Rishi Bommasani is a Senior Research Scholar at Stanford HAI and leads the society work at Stanford CRFM. Their research centers on the economic and societal impacts of frontier AI and on evidence-based AI policy. Bommasani was the lead author of the report "On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models" and of the Foundation Model Transparency Index.
known_for: Lead author of the foundation models report
